terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd code && . .venv/bin/activate && echo 'Waiting for Neo4j on :7687...'; for i in $(seq 1 90); do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/7687) 2>/dev/null && { exec 3>&-; echo 'Neo4j is up'; break; }; sleep 2; done; exec uvicorn backend.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
